title: KyuTweaks
description: "Slight" Tweaks and Additions for vanilla survival.
body:
Brings various Tweaks and Additions such as:
- Most hostile mobs now drop Emeralds!
- Craftable String and cheaper Map recipes
- Reworked most Villager trades
- Chiseled Bookshelves now increase enchanting power like regular Bookshelves
- Vaults and Ominous Vaults instantly refresh on use

I highly reccommend using a mod like [Paxi](https://modrinth.com/mod/paxi) to autoload datapacks from the <modpack>\datapacks\ folder, otherwise you would have to manually add the datapack to the "datapacks" folder rooted in your world files.

*Requires [KyuLib](https://modrinth.com/datapack/kyulib)

Feel free to join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/cYa9VNz9zF) for suggestions and bug reports!
